_doc: David & Goliath voice cast and per-line direction. Read by tools/dg_voice_build.py. Voices are Microsoft neural voices (edge-tts). rate/pitch are edge-tts prosody values; fx names a post chain in dg_voice_build.py (plain, bright, giant, offscreen, crowd). 'lines' holds per-line direction for the voice-record session (m = mood, d = the picture to hold in mind) and optional per-line prosody overrides per language.

goliath.why: big male voice, pitched down to 0.84 and given a hall; cartoon-scary

narrator.why: warm storyteller (same voice as the web battle narrator)

david.why: child voice, nudged down to read as a boy

goliath.why: deep male, pitched down to 0.84 and given a hall; cartoon-scary

dg_01.m: 温暖、讲故事的开头，慢一点
dg_01.d: 画面：睡前，你翻开一本大图画书，孩子靠在你身边。
dg_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime, you open a big picture book and a child leans on you.

dg_02.m: 大声、霸道、拖长音，但像卡通巨人
dg_02.d: 画面：你站在山谷中间，对着对面整支军队喊话，胸口拍得咚咚响。
dg_02.d_en: Picture: you stand in the valley and shout at a whole army, thumping your chest.

dg_03.m: 讲故事，带一点惊讶，“三米”加重
dg_03.d: 画面：你张开双手比划他有多高，孩子眼睛睁得圆圆的。
dg_03.m_en: storyteller, a little amazed, lean on 'three metres'
dg_03.d_en: Picture: you stretch your arms up to show how tall he was; the child's eyes go wide.

dg_04.m: 害怕、小声又急、几个人抢着说
dg_04.d: 画面：你们几个士兵躲在盾牌后面，偷偷往外看。
dg_04.m_en: scared, quick, several people at once
dg_04.d_en: Picture: a few soldiers peeking out from behind their shields.

dg_05.d: 画面：没人敢出来，你仰头哈哈大笑，枪杆在地上一顿。
dg_05.d_en: Picture: nobody comes out; you throw your head back and laugh, banging your spear.

dg_06.d: 画面：远处走来一个提着饭篮的少年，你笑着指给孩子看。
dg_06.m_en: a turn in the story, light, firm at the end
dg_06.d_en: Picture: a boy with a lunch basket walks in from far away; you point him out with a smile.

dg_07.d: 画面：你站在大家面前，挺起胸，认真地说。
dg_07.d_en: Picture: you step in front of everyone, stand tall, and say it plainly.

dg_08.d: 画面：国王弯下腰，手放在你肩膀上，眉头皱着。
dg_08.m_en: kind but worried, like a grandpa
dg_08.d_en: Picture: the king bends down, a hand on the boy's shoulder, frowning.

dg_09.d: 画面：你一边说一边比划狮子和熊扑过来的样子。
dg_09.d_en: Picture: you act out the lion and the bear as you speak.

dg_10.d: 画面：你抬头看天，轻轻地但很肯定地说。
dg_10.d_en: Picture: you look up at the sky and say it softly but surely.

dg_11.m: 有点好笑，盔甲太重走不动
dg_11.d: 画面：你穿着大一号的盔甲，哐当哐当走两步，差点摔倒。
dg_11.m_en: a bit funny, the armour is far too big
dg_11.d_en: Picture: you clank two steps in armour three sizes too big and nearly fall over.

dg_12.d: 画面：小溪哗哗流，你一块一块地捡起石头。
dg_12.m_en: soft and careful, like counting stones
dg_12.d_en: Picture: a bubbling brook; you pick up the stones one by one.

dg_13.m: 瞧不起、逗弄，像大猫逗老鼠
dg_13.d: 画面：你弯腰看着脚边的小孩，故意笑他。
dg_13.d_en: Picture: you bend down to look at the little boy and laugh at him.

dg_14.m: 全场最重要的一句：坚定、响亮、不凶
dg_14.d: 画面：巨人就在眼前，你一点不退，声音传遍山谷。
dg_14.m_en: the key line: firm, ringing, not angry
dg_14.d_en: Picture: the giant is right in front of you; you don't step back and your voice fills the valley.

dg_15.d: 画面：你屏住呼吸，看着少年跑起来，机弦呼呼转。
dg_15.d_en: Picture: holding your breath as the boy runs and the sling whirls.

dg_16.m: 前半句快，“咚”字放慢加重
dg_16.d: 画面：石头飞出去——咚！你拍一下书，孩子吓一跳又笑了。
dg_16.m_en: quick, then slow and heavy on 'Down'
dg_16.d_en: Picture: the stone flies -- thump! you slap the book; the child jumps, then laughs.

dg_17.d: 画面：大家在欢呼，你举起双手，把荣耀归给上帝。
dg_17.d_en: Picture: everyone cheers; you raise your hands and give the glory to God.

dg_18.m: 明亮、温暖的结尾，对孩子说
dg_18.d: 画面：故事讲完了，你合上书，摸摸孩子的头。
dg_18.m_en: bright, warm ending, to the child
dg_18.d_en: Picture: the story is over; you close the book and pat the child's head.
